children: According to Sina Finance, the Israel Defense Forces told residents of a village in southern Lebanon to evacuate a building and the surrounding area before a strike. The Israel Defense Forces said the building it planned to strike was a Hezbollah facility, in response to Hezbollah launching an explosive drone at Israeli forces.

title: Israel Defense Forces Orders Lebanese Village Residents Away From Building Before Strike
